g.text: source() : ShelterSource ' PAASETEAMET (the fixture mirrors the WFS dataset)
coordinates : double[] ' [x, y] in EPSG:3301 (L-EST97, meters)
Re-import: existing externalId = UPDATE, new = CREATE.
Delisting is PER SOURCE (2026-09-08 B7e): only the source this run
client.source() is one of PAASETEAMET / MUNICIPALITY; today only
Päästeamet has a fetcher, so MUNICIPALITY rows are retained until a
municipality client ships (its own run delists its own source).
A zero-row fetch skips delisting entirely (rows retained, log.warn).
Keep-list = EVERY externalId the registry served this run, including
rows that failed the length pre-check or parsing.
User-added shelters (source USER) are never touched.
API filter GET /api/shelters?source=REGISTRY|USER|ALL arrives with the read side.
